violation_type.title: Healthy Environment - No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §742.801(f))
violation_type.short_title: Healthy Environment - No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. Per interviews conducted it was determined staff have smoked on the premises of the daycare during hours of operation.
